3: - **Base URL:** `https://api.start-hack.5u.ai`
4: - **Auth:** header `X-API-Key: <HACKLOOP_API_KEY>` (or `Authorization: Bearer …`). The key is in `router/.env`.

9: ## Mailbox
10: 
11: ### Poll: `GET /v1/mailbox/messages?since_id=N&limit=1..200`
12: 
13: - Returns mail sent **to** us with `id > since_id`, oldest first. Keep `next_since_id` for the next call.

import concurrent.futures, json, subprocess
truckers = [
 ('Elbkante Logistik','elbkante-logistik@hackloop.mail'),
 ('Hansekogge Trucking','hansekogge-trucking@hackloop.mail'),
 ('Nordlicht Haulage','nordlicht-haulage@hackloop.mail'),
 ('Rheinufer Spedition','rheinufer-spedition@hackloop.mail'),
 ('Sternmeile Logistik','sternmeile-logistik@hackloop.mail'),
]
shipments = [('RUH',6,591,1.95),('GRU',6,1335,10.63)]
def run(item):
    label, cmd = item
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
    return label, p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
jobs=[]
for dest,pieces,kg,cbm in shipments:
    body=(f"Hello,\n\nplease quote the following pickup:\nFrom: 20674 Hamburg\nTo: HAM airport (air export warehouse)\nReady date: 2026-11-28\nPieces: {pieces}\nGross weight: {kg} kg\nVolume: {cbm} cbm\n\nPlease reply with your all-in price in EUR, the pickup time and the validity.\n\nBest regards,\nAlex, TALOS Air Freight")
    for name,email in truckers:
        payload={'to':email,'subject':'Pickup quote 20674 Hamburg to HAM on 2026-11-28','body':body}
        jobs.append((f'trucker {name} for {dest}', ['python3','tools/api.py','POST','/v1/mailbox/messages',json.dumps(payload)]))
    jobs.append((f'air {dest}', ['python3','tools/quote_air.py','HAM',dest,str(kg),str(cbm),'--date','2026-11-28']))
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(jobs)) as ex:
    for label,code,out,err in ex.map(run,jobs):
        print(f'===== {label} (exit {code}) =====')
        if err.strip(): print(err.strip())
        print(out.strip())
